ISRO Successfully Launches Advanced Earth Observation Satellite EOS-05

The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) successfully launched its advanced earth observation satellite, EOS-05, into orbit using the GSLV-F17 rocket from the Satish Dhawan Space Centre in Sriharikota. The 2,367-kg satellite was precisely placed into its intended geostationary orbit. ISRO Chairman Dr. V. Narayanan confirmed the successful mission, which ISRO describes as enhancing the country's strategic imaging capabilities. Prime Minister Narendra Modi hailed the launch as an outstanding achievement and a proud moment for the nation.
